cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: Oh hello. I was hoping to speak to Jack Fitzgerald about renting a cottage.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: I'm his wife, Shirley, and we own the cottages together, so I'm sure I can help you.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: Great. My name's Tom.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: Some friends of ours rented Granary Cottage from you last year, and they thought it was

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: great. So my wife and I are hoping to come in May for a week.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: I'll just check ... I'm sorry, Tom, it's already booked that week.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: It's free the week beginning the 28th, though, for seven nights.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: In fact, that's the only time you could have it in May.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: Oh. Well, we could manage that, I think. We'd just need to change a couple of things.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: How much would it cost?

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: That's the beginning of high season, so it'd be £550 for the week.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: Ah. That's a bit more than we wanted to pay, I'm afraid.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: We've budgeted up to £500 for accommodation.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: Well, we've just finished converting another building into a cottage, which we're calling

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: Chervil Cottage.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: That's right. It grows fairly wild around here.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: You could have that for the week you want for £480.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: OK. So could you tell me something about it, please?

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: Of course. The building was built as a garage. It's a little smaller than Granary Cottage.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: Yes, you get to it from the living room through French doors, and we provide two

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: deckchairs.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: We hope to build a patio in the near future, but I wouldn't like to guarantee it'll be

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: finished by May.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: The front door opens onto the old farmyard, and parking isn't a problem – there's plenty

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: of room at the front for that. There are some trees and potted plants there.
